title: Dance therapy in rehabilitation: a two-decade bibliometric analysis (2000–2024)
core_idea: Provide the first longitudinal bibliometric mapping of research on dance therapy in rehabilitation (2000–2024) to characterize the field's intellectual structure, identify key research areas and emerging trends, and visualize collaborations and thematic evolution using Web of Science data and tools (VOSviewer, bibliometrix, Scimago, CiteSpace).
tldr: A systematic bibliometric study that maps two decades of literature on dance therapy in rehabilitation to reveal research areas, trends, and collaboration patterns using established bibliometric tools.
